darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 136: adds three Loop Tools in each Live Preview with independent playback, upper/lower controls, and easier moving and resizing. REC can record the app's playback mix to WAV. Instructions text can be selected and copied, and the complete guide can be exported as a printable PDF. Portable library indexes now sync incrementally; per-library full-scan time tracks active indexing and audio analysis. Includes preview, pitch and selection fixes.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 371: adds Sample Grid with offline browsing, REC recording of playback to WAV, three Loop Tools per Live Preview, and independent playback in the upper and lower editors. Loop regions can be moved, resized and stretched with improved edge scrolling, selection and long-file seeking. Portable library indexes sync incrementally, with more accurate per-library full-scan times. Instructions text can be selected and copied with Ctrl+C or Copy; Export PDF saves the complete guide and keyboard shortcuts as a printable A4 document.
